query: what authentication policy applies to remote requests

seed_memories.content: The server auth policy can be loopback_only, bearer_required, oauth, or public depending on deployment.
OAuth grants are persisted in SQLite with a refresh token fingerprint column for revocation.
Bearer verification caches results for thirty seconds keyed by a SHA-256 of the token.
Non-loopback HTTP requests are rejected unless a token or explicit allow flag is configured.
